title: Happy Birthday to You
description: The most-sung song in the English language, from the Hill sisters' 'Good Morning to All'. Learn it and you can play for every birthday in the room.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: The whole tune in C major with the dotted pickups simplified to even eighths and the left hand reduced to one sustained fifth (C-G, G-D or F-C) per bar.
teachingPoints: Right hand starts with thumb on G4; every 'Hap-py' is two eighths on the same G.
Left hand only plays fifths with fingers 5 and 1: C3-G3, G2-D3 and F2-C3. Practice the three shifts alone.
Bar 6 leaps up to G5 with finger 5, then comes down 5-3-1 and crosses 3 over to B4.
Bar 8 is the only bar where the left hand changes chord mid-bar (C then G on beat 3) - count it out loud.
